entries.title: Psalms 68:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. A Song. Let God arise, let His enemies be scattered; also let those who hate Him flee before Him.

entries.title: Psalms 68:2
segments: As smoke is driven away, You drive [them] away; as wax melts before the fire, let the wicked perish in the presence of God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:3
segments: But the righteous are glad; they rejoice before God. Yes, let them exceedingly rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 68:4
segments: Sing to God, sing praises to His name; praise Him who rides on the heavens by His name JEHOVAH, and rejoice before Him.

entries.title: Psalms 68:5
segments: In His holy dwelling God [is] the father of the fatherless, and the judge of the widows.

entries.title: Psalms 68:6
segments: God causes the lonely to live at home; He brings out those who are bound with chains; but the rebellious dwell in a dry [land].

entries.title: Psalms 68:7
segments: O God, when You marched before Your people, when You walked through the wilderness; Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 68:8
segments: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God; Sinai itself [was moved] at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 68:9
segments: You, O God, sent a plentiful rain, by which You upheld Your inheritance when it was weary.

entries.title: Psalms 68:10
segments: Your flock has dwelt in it; You, O God, have prepared in Your goodness for the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 68:11
segments: The Lord gave the word; the bearers of it [were] a great army.

entries.title: Psalms 68:12
segments: Kings of armies fled away; and she who stayed at home divided the plunder.

entries.title: Psalms 68:13
segments: When you lie among the sheepfolds, the wings of a dove [are] covered with silver, and its pinions with the shimmer of gold.

entries.title: Psalms 68:14
segments: When the Almighty scatters kings in it, it snows on Salmon.

entries.title: Psalms 68:15
segments: The mountain of Bashan [is] God's mountain; the Bashan range [is] a mountain of peaks.

entries.title: Psalms 68:16
segments: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountain range, [at the] mountain God has chosen for His resting place? Yes, the LORD will dwell [in it] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 68:17
segments: The chariots of God [are] myriads, thousands of thousands; the Lord [is] among them, in Sinai, in the holy place.

entries.title: Psalms 68:18
segments: You have gone up on high; You have led captivity captive; You have received gifts for men, yes, [for] the rebellious also, that [You] might dwell among them, O Jehovah God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:19
segments: Blessed [is] the LORD; He daily bears burdens for us, the God of our salvation. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 68:20
segments: Our God [is] the God of salvation; and to the LORD [are] the issues of death.

entries.title: Psalms 68:21
segments: Yea, God shall wound the head of His enemies, [and] the hairy crown of him who walks on in his guilt.

entries.title: Psalms 68:22
segments: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan; I will bring back [My people] from the depths of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 68:23
segments: so that your foot may be dipped in the blood of [your] enemies, and the tongue of your dogs in it.

entries.title: Psalms 68:24
segments: They have seen Your goings, O God; the goings of my God, my King, in the holy place.

entries.title: Psalms 68:25
segments: The singers went before, then the musicians came; among [them were] the virgins playing the timbrels.

entries.title: Psalms 68:26
segments: O bless God in the congregations, the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 68:27
segments: There [is] little Benjamin [with] their ruler, the leaders of Judah and their multitude, the leaders of Zebulun, and the leaders of Naphtali.

entries.title: Psalms 68:28
segments: Your God has commanded your strength; O God, be strong [in] that which You have worked out for us.

entries.title: Psalms 68:29
segments: Because of Your temple in Jerusalem, kings shall bring a present to You.

entries.title: Psalms 68:30
segments: Rebuke the wild beasts of the reeds, the herd of bulls, with the calves of the peoples, trampling down with the pieces of silver. He scatters the people [who] delight in war.

entries.title: Psalms 68:31
segments: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall stretch out her hands to God.

entries.title: Psalms 68:32
segments: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises to the Lord. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 68:33
segments: To Him who rides on the heavens of heavens of old; lo, He sends out His voice, a mighty voice.

entries.title: Psalms 68:34
segments: Give strength to God over Israel; His majesty and His strength in the skies.

entries.title: Psalms 68:35
segments: O God, You [are] overwhelming out of Your holy places; the God of Israel [is] He who gives strength and powers to the people. Blessed [is] God.
